# ANVIL — ROLE B / Round 01: PhotoBank Sorting Completed

The intake checkpoint and PhotoBank sorting pass for the Anvil product library has been executed within all governance, offline, and runtime boundaries.

---

### Reconciliation Summary

$$\mathbf{95\text{ Source Images}} = \mathbf{95\text{ Sorted}} + \mathbf{0\text{ Duplicates}} + \mathbf{0\text{ Review}}$$

- **Source Ingestion & Byte Integrity**: Exactly 95 JPG images discovered in `assets/Anvil products`. Source files were accessed read-only; post-run verification confirmed that all 95 source files remain **100% byte-identical** to their initial hashes and sizes.
- **Destination Integrity**: Exactly 95 files placed across 95 distinct SKU variant folders under `bank/`. Destination SHA-256 hashes match source hashes 1:1.
- **Budget & Offline Enforcement**: Executed entirely locally using `clip-venv` (`ViT-L-14` "openai" on CUDA) under `HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1` and `TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1`. **0 paid API calls, 0 network downloads, 0 image generations**.
- **Perceptual Duplicate Audit**: 6 heuristic duplicate candidates detected in G001 were audited visually against packaging label banners and confirmed as **false positives** (13 distinct flavors of TVN Beyond Elite Protein Bars). Pre-correction metadata was archived to `clusters_pre_correction.json` and `files_pre_correction.json`, flags were reconciled in `_work/`, and full rationale was logged to `duplicate_reconciliation.log`.
- **Near-Twin Pass Audit**: Because each product variant was mapped to its own leaf folder (`brand/product_type/product/sku_variant`), `twin_groups.json` reports **0 twin pairs and 0 hidden cards**. Every verified variant has a distinct, fully visible primary card in `BANK.html`.

---
